en.headline: Customs seize 5.1kg cannabis buds and other items at airport, arrest man
en.dek: A 42-year-old mainland passenger from Bangkok was arrested after officers found suspected cannabis, Part I poisons and duty-not-paid cigarettes worth about HK$1.06 million.
body: Hong Kong Customs said on Monday that it detected a drug trafficking case involving an incoming passenger at Hong Kong International Airport and seized about 5.1 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds, three types of products containing suspected Part I poison, and 261 sticks of duty-not-paid cigarettes, with a total estimated market value of about HK$1.06 million.
A 42-year-old mainland male passenger arrived from Bangkok, Thailand. During customs clearance, officers found the items inside his carry-on baggage and arrested him.

He has been charged with trafficking in a dangerous drug, possession of dutiable goods, failing to declare dutiable goods, and possession of Part I poison. The case will be brought up at the West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲5.1公斤大麻花蕾等物品 拘捕一名男子
zh.dek: 一名42歲內地旅客由曼谷抵港，海關在其手提行李發現懷疑大麻、第I部毒藥及未完稅香煙，市值約106萬元。
body: 香港海關周一表示，在香港國際機場檢獲涉及入境旅客的販毒案件，檢獲約5.1公斤懷疑大麻花蕾、三類含懷疑第I部毒藥的產品及261支未完稅香煙，估計總市值約106萬港元。
一名42歲內地男旅客由泰國曼谷抵港。清關時，人員在其手提行李內發現有關物品，隨即將他拘捕。
他已被控一項販運危險藥物、一項管有應課稅品、一項未向海關人員申報管有應課稅品及一項管有第I部毒藥。案件將於周二在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
